payload.name: The State of the Shadow-Cursed Lands

consequences.lore: The Shadow Curse over Reithwin is breaking. Green creeps back across poisoned ground, the dead grow quiet, and a great healer has stayed behind to shepherd the land's slow recovery and the orphans resettling there.

The curse never lifted. Reithwin and the lands around Moonrise stay drowned in unnatural dark; the things that hunt there still hunt, and a single grim warden holds a line that cannot be won, only held.

The dark was contained but not cured: the Flaming Fist threw a cordon around the Shadow-Cursed Lands and call it a quarantine. Smugglers run the line, deserters hide past it, and the curse waits behind the wire.

payload.hook: The healing land keeps turning up things the curse had swallowed — a buried hamlet, a sealed crypt, a name on a gravestone someone in the city has been searching for. The warden of Reithwin needs hands he can trust.

outcomes.hook: The healing land keeps turning up things the curse had swallowed — a buried hamlet, a sealed crypt, a name on a gravestone someone in the city has been searching for. The warden of Reithwin needs hands he can trust.
The lone warden of the cursed lands has gone silent. The last traveler back from the dark says his lantern still burns at Last Light — but no one answers the door.
Something valuable was left behind the quarantine line when it went up, and more than one party is quietly hiring runners willing to cross into the dark to fetch it.
